title: Vivid Smoky Ukrainian Morning-glory-pak-bung Paella
description: A twist on traditional Ukrainian cuisine featuring morning-glory-pak-bung with a smoky twist. This gluten-free-friendly dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat. Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic cloves and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes, until tender.
Add the smoked paprika, sea salt, and freshly ground black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the boneless chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the bunch of morning-glory-pak-bung and chicken broth to the pan. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the morning-glory-pak-bung is tender.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
